Silica morphology and surface potential in target medium remain unspecified.

actual_finding: Quantified Mo uptake in strong nitric acid supplies an inventory check and comparator, not Mo36 retention.

Langmuir capacity is fitted and cannot be applied to a smaller-feed run.
Molecular species and seed activity unresolved; porous enclosure and renewal unmeasured.
next_alternative: B3: unfunctionalized TiO2 if ZrO2 sequesters inactive species or fails flux.
